description: Test Plane C — Adversarial Conflict Cases (Inversion Thinking). These cases verify that the L5 Consensus Engine (FSM) and L6 Audit Node correctly DETECT and HANDLE attacks: domain contamination, hallucinated claims, unresolved hard conflicts, and false provenance. Each case defines the injected attack and the EXPECTED defensive response.

cases.description: ATTACK: @Horo_BaZi_Node emits a claim referencing 四化 (Si Hua — a ZiWei concept) in its statement. This is a Domain Firewall violation — BaZi Nodes MUST NOT reference ZiWei concepts.

claims.statement: The Day Master shows 化禄 transformation (化禄入命) indicating wealth influx

cases.expected_detection_reason: Term '化禄' is in the forbidden_terms list for ming_xue_bazi domain (belongs to ming_xue_ziwei)
cases.pass_condition: L6 Audit Node must flag this claim and reduce source_support to 0.0

cases.description: ATTACK: A claim is emitted with source_corpus referencing a non-existent book '秘传奇门秘诀' that is not in any canonical corpus list. This simulates LLM hallucination of fake classical references.

claims.statement: The 天蓬星 in central palace indicates hidden attack from northeast

cases.expected_detection_reason: source_corpus '秘传奇门秘诀' not found in QiMen Convention Profile canonical_corpus list
cases.pass_condition: RNIw raised by materiality_weight=0.9 * 1 (ungrounded) — must exceed threshold 0.15

cases.expected_detection_reason: Source corpus '协纪辨方书' belongs to ze_ji_xue domain, not ming_xue_bazi — false provenance detected

cases.description: ATTACK: All three tradition nodes (@Horo_BaZi_Node, @Horo_ZiWei_Node, @Horo_QiMen_Node) agree that 'the subject will become wealthy in 2026' with high cross_agent_agreement=0.95. Inversion test: L6 Audit must check if this consensus is grounded or a shared hallucination pattern (all nodes citing the same questionable interpretation).

injected_claims.statement: Subject will achieve significant wealth accumulation in 2026
Subject will achieve significant wealth accumulation in 2026
Subject will achieve significant wealth accumulation in 2026

cases.expected_detection: RNIw elevated due to low source_support across all nodes despite high cross_agent_agreement — consensus without corpus grounding is a confirmation bias pattern
cases.pass_condition: L6 must emit WARNING: 'high cross_agent_agreement with low source_support indicates potential echo chamber — flag for HITL review'

inversion_thinking_protocol.description: L6 Audit Node must apply inversion thinking: ask 'What would have to be FALSE for this claim to be wrong?' for each high-materiality claim
steps: 1. Identify the 3 highest materiality claims in the emission set
2. For each: hypothesize the negation and check if any existing claim supports the negation
3. If negation-supporting claims exist but were not flagged as conflicts — escalate to HITL
4. Check for echo chamber: if cross_agent_agreement > 0.9 but source_support < 0.5 for all agreeing agents — warn
